requiredDecisions: Confirm provider account terms and the intended Philippine under-13 audience.
Resolve privacy, retention, school/guardian arrangements and content safeguards.
Choose an approved model and review its specific retention terms.
Choose a backend host and real endpoint; keep provider and Firebase credentials outside the website workspace.
Approve API/hosting costs and configure provider-side spending controls.
Review request ceilings for the actual class size and budget; the draft values are not a spending guarantee.
Review and back up the existing settings before any intentional migration.
